data.name: Survivors of the Dawn
data.detailed_description:
QUINTILLIONS OF BULLETS AGAINST QUINTILLIONS OF ALIEN CHAOS

Survivors of the Dawn is a rogue-lite horde-survival bullet heaven. Bombard QUINTILLIONS of hordes with QUINTILLIONS of bullets! Mix weapons with items, modify, control chaos at terminals and break through tightening waves.

MODIFY, MAX OUT, TAKE RISKS

Want bigger attacks? or Need the shots to go through more enemies? Bullet Count and Pierce comes to the rescue! Get items and modify your weapons in the Armory. You can also fire faster with Bullet Speed or reduce Reload Time. Max out weapons in the Upgrade System. Meanwhile, take risks for higher rewards with the Rarity System!

MIX WEAPONS WITH ITEMS

Level up weapons, stack items, mix and match to WIPE OUT hordes. Oh, extra allies or sparkly power-ups? Just max out some weapon classes.

GO ALL IN ON TERMINALS

Feeling overwhelmed? Activate the S.O.S to catch your breath. Craving more action? Summon extra hordes at Wanted. Tag along with the Spider bot to heal, and react to the Unknown Signal for more or less dificulty and find some Reroll or Skip chances if lucky enough!

Oh, boy... Meta-progression is far from guaranteed unless you spend your Bounty Bits before your next run!

Team

indieGiant Games is a micro studio with massive ideas based in Istanbul, Türkiye. We make games that we are excited to play and share them with you.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 or AMD Radeon R9 290
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3050 or AMD RX 6500XT
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires an Apple processor
  • Processor: M1
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
